request:
Which test files contain an import statement that imports the click.testing module or any name from it? A test that only reaches click.testing through an attribute of the click package without importing it does not count. tests/conftest.py counts as a test file. Give the repository-relative path of each test file.

Requested output columns: test_file_path (string).
explanation: Selects distinct test files that have an import statement whose module_name is click.testing or a submodule of it. Test files are identified via code.files.is_test, which includes tests/conftest.py. Attribute-only access to click.testing does not appear in code.imports, so it is excluded.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.file_id AS test_file_path FROM code.imports i JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = i.file_id WHERE f.is_test = TRUE AND (i.module_name = 'click.testing' OR i.module_name LIKE 'click.testing.%') ORDER BY test_file_path
